d:
Independence is a Malayalam fantasy film directed by Vinayan and starring Vani Viswanath, Khushbu, Kalabhavan Mani and Indraja in the lead roles.All lyrics are written by S. Ramesan Nair; all music is composed by Suresh Peters.The film was a commercial boxoffice hit.
Song : Nandalaala Hey Nandalaala...
Movie : Independence
Lyrics : S Ramesan Nair
Music : Suresh Peters
Singers : Swarnalatha & Chorus
